title: Equation Library of the Human–AI Readout Programme (v1.0): root registry of Readout Genesis, canonical registry of every programme equation with persistent codes, occurrence map, and Coq identifiers
description_html:
What this is. The programme's central equation registry: (1) the root layer — every equation and named result of Readout Genesis (git-anchored) with its own identifier reused verbatim as code RG-<Part>.<id>; (2) the canonical layer — every distinct equation object across the programme's deposited papers, written in its latest formulation as a reading of a root object, coded <root>/<D>.<nn>.v<k> (D = epistemic, human–AI, social, world-system, method); (3) the occurrence map — every numbered equation of every chapter of the textbook Written by AI. Still True. (raw inventory, 40 chapters) mapped to exactly one canonical code; sources are never edited, the map is the record; (4) Coq identifiers and tiers (Th_coqc / Definition / Open) from the companion Coq record; (5) the generated EQ_LIBRARY.md view. Principle (Readout Genesis): there is one equation; each domain is the same equation read through that domain's readout. The collapse target is a root spine that a single reader can follow from start to end without drift; drift notes are recorded, not hidden.

Status. K0 working release; counts are computed from the JSON files at build time; Th_coqc certifies internal consistency of stated finite models, never empirical truth. An AI assistant assisted under the author's direction; no AI system is an author or contributor.
